text:
We cannot give you a typical day, because almost never do we know what an ordinary believer felt through an ordinary week. We can tell you what was decided about a person, how carefully, and by whom. Both of our own voices are bishops, so what comes down to us is mostly what a bishop saw and decided.

Some parts of our common life we can still describe. Augustine taught that these gifts help only those who earned that help in life. Augustine's mother, Monica, asked as she lay ill that she be remembered at the Lord's altar.

We baptized infants, and we would not make a newborn wait. In Cyprian's time we took back the failed rather than shutting them out for good.
